query: For any complex polynomial `p ∈ ℂ[X]`, `Σ_{i ∈ supp p} ‖p.coeff i‖² = (1 / 2π) ∫₀^{2π} ‖p(e^{iθ})‖² dθ`. That is, Parseval's identity on the unit circle, read coefficient-wise.
